Commentary.Commentary: Welcome back, folks! The Netherlands players are on the ground. Philip Salt and Jason Roy are the English openers, both in scintillating form. Fred Klaassen to begin proceedings with the first new ball. No slip in place, strangely. Here we go...
...THE RUN CHASE…

Right then, the target is not a big one for this strong English batting line-up. However, this is cricket and one can never rule out a possibility of a surprise. Can the Netherlands pull off something special to cap off a historic series at home? Let's find out as we will be back with England's reply in a short while. Stay tuned.

England would be pretty pleased with their bowling effort!. There was not much help for the bowlers but they came in with a definite plan and executed it quite well in the end. The plan from the seamers was to bowl short and that brought them rich dividends. David Willey provided the first breakthrough with a bouncer to Vikramjit Singh and then Carse with his extra pace continued to bowl short and trouble the batters. He got Cooper and Bas de Leede with his short-pitch stuff and spinners Livingstone and Rashid too did their job to perfection. However, it was the death-over bowling that was most impressive for England as Willey finished with four wickets and the debutant David Payne also got his maiden wicket as he got Edwards out in the end.

Earlier in the match, the Netherlands lost the wicket of Vikramjit Singh cheaply but Tom Cooper and Max O'Dowd steadied the ship nicely and scored at a brisk pace during their 72-run stand. Cooper got a life when he was on zero courtesy of Liam Livingstone losing the ball in the sun but he departed soon after a promising start. Max O'Dowd, on the other hand, continued to be steady but lost his wicket after getting to his fifty. There was a handy partnership in the middle overs between Bas de Leede and Scott Edwards but both of them could not kick on to get a big one. As mentioned earlier, the lack of firepower cost them dearly as the pressure of getting to 300 against a strong English batting unit got to them and they eventually crumbled in the death overs.

Yet another Dutch innings that just never took off! The lack of firepower in their batting line-up has cost them once again. They were found out in the last 10 overs when they needed to up the ante and overall they will be disappointed with this batting effort. They have ended with 244 on the board and though the score looks decent, it is way below-par on this batting strip and especially against the firepower of the English batting. The Netherlands need to pull off something special to defend this one while the English batters will be pretty confident of chasing down another total without much fuss.

OUT! BOWLED! Willey has four in the match. He hurls across a length ball, around middle and off at 129 kph, Paul van Meekeren clears his front leg for a big heave over the leg side but misses. The off stump is disturbed and the Netherlands are bundled out for 244.
Off pace delivery, a bit on the shorter side, Fred Klaassen pushes it through covers for a single. Can they get to 250?
Full again, wide outside off, Paul drives but finds the cover fielder. End of David Payne's spell for this match. He did a decent job.
Fullish and wide outside off, Paul van Meekeren slices his drive through point and collects a couple of runs.
Fuller and on middle, knocked down to long on for a run.
Paul van Meekeren is the last man in.

OUT! CAUGHT! Big smile on the face of David Payne as he claims his maiden ODI wicket. Fuller in length, around off at 119 kph, Scott Edwards is early into the swing of his bat and gets it away off the inner half of his blade. The ball lobs up to mid on and Jason Roy takes the catch by shuffling back and across a bit to his right. Can the Netherlands play out all their balls now?
Commentary.Howout: c Jason Roy b David Payne

Commentary.Commentary: Fuller this time, wide outside off, Fred throws his bat at it and edges it down to third man for a single.
Wide! Sliding down the leg side, Fred Klaassen tries to glance but misses.
Bouncer around off, Scott tries to pull but misses. It pings him on the helmet and goes to third man. They cross for a leg bye. Surprisingly, there is no concussion test conducted.
Fred Klaassen is the next man in.

OUT! BOWLED! David Willey has three wickets. He delivers an inswinger, on a fuller length around middle. Aryan Dutt tries to heave it over the leg side but misses. It nips in, perhaps takes some part of his pads too before deflecting onto the stumps. The Dutchmen have been unable to maximize the end overs.
Turns a length ball through mid-wicket and collects a single.
Back of a length, around off, Scott tries to work it on the leg side but gets a bit of an outside edge. It rolls to point.
Slower one, on a length around off, Dutt pushes at it but misses. Buttler gets a bad bounce and fumbles. They cross for a bye.
Outside off, on a length and angling away, Dutt flashes his bat at it but misses.
Shortish and on middle, powered to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Around leg, on a length, Edwards tickles it down to fine leg for a run.
Aryan Dutt is the next man in.

OUT! RUN OUT! Pringle sacrifices himself for his skipper. Slower delivery, full and around middle, Tim Pringle pushes it gently to covers and there is no run available as it has gone straight to the fielder. Scott Edwards though wants to get back on strike and pushes his partner. Pringle initially signals to send his skipper back but then decides to cross. Meanwhile, Dawid Malan tosses the ball to the bowler who takes the bails off. Tim Pringle is not even in the frame.
Short and around middle, pulled to deep mid-wicket for a single.

Slower short ball around leg, Edwards tries to pull but is early into the shot. It takes his gloves, deflects off the arms and Buttler rushes across to collect it after dropping one of his gloves. The ball though spins and beats him. It also misses Buttler's glove on the ground by a whisker, otherwise, it would have been five penalty runs. Two added to the total.
Wide called for height! David Payne digs it in short and it goes over the head of the batter.
On a shortish length around middle, Edwards heaves it over mid-wicket, finds the gap and collects a couple of runs.
Fuller and on middle, defended back.
David Payne (7-1-26-0) is back into the attack.

Direct hit would have been curtains for Scott Edwards. This one is delivered on a length around off, Edwards drops it down with gentle hands on the leg side and rushes across for a run. David Willey is quick to get to the ball, he slides, turns, and has three stumps to aim at but fails to find the target. Edwards survives.
Fuller and on middle, it's driven down towards mid on. Sam Curran dives but fails to make a clean stop. The mid-off fielder chases it down and they get three runs.
Short and on middle, pulled in front of square leg for a run.
Width there outside off, short in length, Pringle cuts it through backward point and picks up a single.
Around middle and off, on a length, Tim defends it back from the crease.
Slants across a length ball, around off, Edwards pushes at it and edges it down to third man for a single.
Shortish googly, outside off, Pringle gets back to cut but mistimes it to covers. Adil Rashid is done with his spell of 10 overs. 1 for 41 for the leggie this evening.
Flatter this time, around middle, Pringle stays back and defends it towards the bowler.
Too full in length on middle, Edwards clips it through mid-wicket and asks his partner to run hard. He eyes two runs but gets only a run.
Tossed up around middle, Pringle works this googly behind square leg for a run.
Short and wide outside off, Edwards cuts it to deep point for a single.
Floated around off, Tim gets forward to defend but gets an outside edge. It goes wide of Moeen at first slip and they cross.
Fullish and on off, it's speared in, Scott digs it out to covers.
Tim Pringle walks in next.

OUT! Soft dismissal! David Willey hurls across a full delivery, around middle and leg at 132 kph, Logan van Beek leans across to flick it on the leg side but closes the face of his bat early. It lobs in the air off the leading edge and Adil Rashid at mid off takes the simplest of catches. It's going downhill for the Dutch team.
Commentary.Howout: c Adil Rashid b David Willey

Commentary.Commentary: Back of a length and outside off, Logan tries to run it down to third man despite a slip fielder being there. Ends up missing the ball completely.
Too full and around off, Logan van Beek pushes it out to covers, not in the gap.
This time Edwards uses the angle of the bowler and guides it down to third man for a single.
Beaten! Angling away from the batter, on a shortish length, Scott Edwards flashes his bat at but fails to connect.
Logan van Beek walks out to the middle and Jos Buttler makes a bowling change too. David Willey (5-0-25-1) is back on.

OUT! STUMPED! Adil Rashid gets his man this time. He serves a loopy leg spinner around off, Teja Nidamanuru advances down the track for a big shot but the ball turns away slightly to beat his bat. Jos Buttler, behind the stumps, needs no second invitation to dislodge the bails. Netherlands have now lost half their side.
Commentary.Howout: st Jos Buttler b Adil Rashid

Commentary.Commentary: FIFTY FOR EDWARDS, his 8th in ODIs. He has been in fine form and has scored 200 runs in the series so far. Leans forward and pushes a full ball to covers. Takes a single. His presence is critical for the Netherlands till the end.
Flatter googly, from the front of the hand, around off, Edwards keeps it out next to the pitch.
Googly, on the shorter side around off, Teja shuffles back and helps it through mid-wicket for a run.
Fuller and around off, driven to covers.

Shout for an lbw! Not given and Jos Buttler takes the DRS. Looked like an inside edge. A nicely-tossed up delivery, a googly landing full around off. Teja Nidamanuru tries to heave it across the line but fails to get any proper connection. He is pinged on the back leg, they appeal but the finger stays down. England opt for the DRS. The UltraEdge finds a BIG SPIKE and the tourists lose a review.
Adil Rashid is back on. Eight overs for 35 runs so far.
Two again. Fuller and around off, Scott gently works it in the gap behind square leg and returns for the second run.
Heaves a length ball to deep square leg and rushes back for the second run.
Back of a length, around off, moving back in again, this time Teja gets an inside edge and it goes to fine leg. The batters cross.

Shout for an lbw! Not out, says the umpire. A little bit of reverse on this delivery, at 88 mph. A touch short around off, shaping in, Teja Nidamanuru fails to defend off the back foot, and is clipped on the back leg. Too high, perhaps.
Width there outside off, Edwards uses the pace of the bowler and guides it down to third man for a single.
Bowls it full and around off, Edwards drives but finds the cover fielder.
A touch short and around leg, Scott nudges it down to fine leg and runs the first run hard. That's all he will get.
Slower one, full and around off, Teja Nidamanuru eases it gently to covers and steals a single.
The length is again on the shorter side, around off, Teja Nidamanuru pulls but finds mid-wicket.
Short and on middle, pulled down to fine leg for a run.
Around off, angling away, it's kept out towards point.
Fuller in length, around middle and leg, Teja Nidamanuru flicks it to deep square leg and gets off the mark with a single.
Powerplay 3 time. One extra fielder, i.e. 5 can now be put outside the 30-yard circle till the end of this inning. Meanwhile, Teja Nidamanuru has joined his skipper in the middle.

OUT! CAUGHT! Carse gets his second wicket and Bas de Leede departs now after a handy fifty. It is that short ball from Carse that does the trick yet again! Bangs it short on off. Bas de Leede is hurried by the extra pace and ends up getting a top edge. It goes up in the air towards the square leg region. Adil Rashid moves to his right from mid-wicket and takes a fine tumbling catch. A timely breakthrough for the Englishmen.
Commentary.Howout: c Adil Rashid b Brydon Carse

Commentary.Commentary: Back of a length, around off. Edwards dabs it towards third man for a single.
No, he misses out! On a length and around off. Edwards swings across the line but misses.
NO BALL AND FOUR! 200 comes up! Carse bowls a high full toss, around off. Edwards slams it towards wide long on for a boundary. There will be a Free Hit coming up. Can Scott Edwards go big this time?
On a length, around off. Bas de Leede dabs it towards point for a single.
On a length, on middle. Bas de Leede nudges it towards mid-wicket.
FOUR! Much-needed boundary for the Netherlands! Carse with a short delivery on middle and leg. Bas de Leede pulls and beats the diving fine leg fielder in the deep for a boundary.
Very good over, just two from it! On a length, on off. Edwards defends it towards the off side.
Goes a bit fuller on middle. Edwards pushes it to mid on. Dot ball again!
A bouncer again, on off. Edwards misses his pull shot again. Good bowling, this!
Bangs it short and it is a pacy delivery, around leg. Edwards tries to pull but misses.
Pulls his length back a bit and it is slower again at 120 kph. Edwards mistimes his pull shot to deep backward square leg for a couple.
A slower delivery to start a new spell. On a length, on middle. Edwards works it to mid-wicket.
Pace from both ends now. David Payne (5-1-20-0) is back into the attack.
On a length, on off. Edwards pushes it towards the off side for a single.

Dropped! Malan took a good catch earlier in the innings but he has dropped a pretty straightforward catch here! Carse bangs it short on off. Edwards tries to hook it. However, he gets a huge top edge. The ball goes towards the fine leg region and Dawid Malan there misjudges it a bit and drops the catch in the end. Two runs are taken.
Back of a length, on middle. Edwards pulls it to deep mid-wicket for a couple.
Fullish length, on middle. Bit of reverse-swing there and Edwards plays it back to the bowler.
Big swing and a miss! Lands on a length, outside off. Edwards goes for a mighty swing across the line but misses it completely.
NO BALL! Carse oversteps here! On a length, outside off. Bas de Leede drives it towards sweeper cover for a single. A Free Hit coming up.
A length delivery angling into leg. Edwards clips it to fine leg for a single.
Brydon Carse is back on. 1 for 24 in his 5 overs so far.
A fuller one on middle. Bas de Leede clips it but finds the fielder at short mid-wicket.
Pushed quicker on off. Bas de Leede blocks it out.
Angling into middle and leg. Edwards sweeps it to short fine leg for a single.
A flatter one on middle and leg. Edwards looks to paddle it away but does not get the connection.

Fifty for Bas de Leede! This has been a nicely paced innings from him! However, he would know that he needs to kick on and get a big one here to take his team close to 300 here, if not over. Fuller delivery on off. Bas de Leede drives it to long on for a single. His proud father is there in the stands, clapping for him.
Tossed up on off. Bas de Leede defends it off the inside half of his blade to short mid-wicket.

Drinks break. The Dutch team continues to be steady despite losing two set batters, Tom Cooper and Max O'Dowd, in the last period of play. Bas de Leede and Scott Edwards have formed another partnership, and are scoring at a decent click as well. That said, they will need to maximize the end overs as the hosts will need a total of above 300 to challenge this brutal English batting line-up. Can they do it?
A length delivery again that is angled across the batter. It is outside off and Bas de Leede steers it towards third man for a single.
Lands on a length, on off. Edwards defends it towards the off side with soft hands and takes a single.
Goes fuller on off. Bas de Leede drives it to deep extra cover and once again the running is very good as the batters take three.
Tight line again, on off. Bas de Leede only manages to defend this length delivery again.
On a length, on off. Bas de Leede with a front-foot block on the off side.
A short ball on middle. Edwards pulls it bit uppishly towards deep backward square leg for a single.
On middle and leg and flatter this time. Edwards nudges it past short fine leg for a single.
Rashid continues to give some air on the ball, on middle. Bas de Leede drives it to long on for a single.
A fuller one again, on middle. Edwards reverse-sweeps it to short third man for a single.

FOUR! Good shot! The mid-off fielder is inside the circle and this is a pretty safe shot! It is fuller on off. Edwards stays deep in his crease and slams it straight down the ground for a boundary. The 50-run stand comes up.
A googly that pitches on middle. Edwards reverse-sweeps it to short third man.
Tosses this up, on off. Bas de Leede drives it to long off for a single.
Change of ends for Adil Rashid. 0 for 25 in his 6 overs so far.
Ends the over with another short one, angling into middle from 'round the wicket. Bas de Leede pulls it along the ground to deep square leg for a single.
A slower short delivery, outside off. Bas de Leede lets it go.
Two more! Curran with a short delivery on off. Bas de Leede pulls it but mistimes it towards the backward square leg region. However, the batters are alert enough and take a couple of runs again.
Good running! Lands on a length, on off. Bas de Leede pushes it square of the wicket on the off side and comes back for the second run.
On a length, around off. It is angled across the batter and he guides it to third man for a single.
Back of a length, around off. Bas de Leede dabs it towards backward point for a single.
Change in bowling. Sam Curran comes back into the attack. 4-0-22-0 are his figures so far.
Tad slower this time on off. Scott Edwards blocks it off the front foot.
A flatter one and a bit quicker too on off. Bas de Leede pushes it towards the off side and a single is taken again.
A quick single! A flatter one on off. Edwards blocks it with soft hands towards the off side and takes a single.
Livingstone serves it on middle. Edwards works it to deep mid-wicket for a couple.
This is fuller and outside off. Bas de Leede drives it to deep cover for a single.
Tossed up on off. Bas de Leede with a front-foot defence.
This is angling on middle. Bas de Leede works it to square leg for a single.
Goes flatter on middle. Bas de Leede blocks it out.
TWO WIDES! Rashid drifts down the leg side. Edwards looks to clip it but misses. Buttler fails to collect it cleanly and a bye is taken.
Slight halt in play. Scott Edwards adjusting his pads and getting some repairs done.

Rashid pulls his length back a bit and bowls it on middle. Edwards works it wide of long on and comes back for the second run. He puts in a dive to complete the second run and makes his ground easily in the end.
Slower in the air, on off. Bas de Leede drives it to long off for a single.
Fuller on off. Bas de Leede defends it off the front foot.
Pitches it on off and turns away a bit. Edwards guides it to short third man for a single.
Sligthly on the shorter side, around off. Edwards punches it to sweeper cover for a single.
Another flatter delivery on off. Edwards only manages to block it.
Pushes it quicker on off. Scott Edwards blocks it off the front foot.
Goes fuller and outside off. Edwards drives it to deep extra cover for a couple.
This is slower in the air and fuller. Bas de Leede drives it to long off for a single.
A flatter one and slightly shorter in length, around off. Bas de Leede looks to cut but mistimes it.
Tossed up, around off, Bas de Leede uses his feet and wrists it down through mid on for a single.
Very full and outside off, Bas drills it through extra cover and David Willey makes a fine stop in the deep, running across and sliding to his left from long off. Saves two runs.
Walks down to the pitch of the delivery and helps it towards short mid-wicket.
Floated and around off, defended off the front foot.
Flighted and full, around off, Scott gets across the stumps and sweeps it to deep backward square leg for a run.
Loopy and around leg, it's worked to the left of square leg for a run.
Outside off, eased to deep cover for one. The two spinners are rushing through their overs and not giving away many runs.
Gets forward and drives it firmly but finds the cover fielder.
Edgy but safe! Tossed up, around middle and leg, Scott Edwards top-edges his attempted sweep shot and it falls just wide of short fine leg. They cross.
Loopy and around leg, Bas de Leede gets forward to take it on the full and strokes it towards covers for one.
Allows the ball to spin away, it's short and Scott hangs back to force it through point for a run.
Short and around off, a gentle delivery, Bas goes back and cuts it to deep cover for a single.
Uses his feet and eases a full ball down to long on for a run.
Loopy and full, wide outside off, Bas de Leede goes for the drive but only manages to mistime it back towards the bowler.
That is defended solidly off the front foot to short mid-wicket.
Slower through the air, around off, Bas defends it back.
Full and around off, pushed through wide mid off for a run.
Loopy and on middle, flicked to mid-wicket.
Wide! Flighted delivery, full and down the leg side, Scott Edwards shapes up to play the reverse sweep but then attempts to unveil a conventional one, but fails to connect.
That is defended solidly off the front foot on the leg side.
Shortish around off, Bas de Leede goes back and slaps it to deep cover for a couple of runs.
Play and a miss! Grip and turn outside off, some extra bounce, Bas de Leede goes back to cut but it goes over his blade.
MISFIELD! Flighted and around middle and leg, Edwards plays the reverse sweep and the fielder at point misfields. It scoots behind and stops before the fence. They take three runs.
Floated delivery, drifting in and landing around middle, Bas de Leede strokes it down to long off for a run.
Pushes it quicker through the air, around off, de Leede works it off the inner half to mid-wicket.
Slower through the air, full and around off, Bas pushes it gently to cover-point and takes a single.
Flighted and around middle, the batter moves back and quietly works it in front of square leg for a single.
Too full and around off, it's driven to deep cover for a single.
Lunges to a full ball and defends it back.
Flighted and around leg, Bas gets down the track and flicks it towards mid-wicket.
Loopy and full, around leg, Edwards clips it to square leg and takes a single.
Presses forward to a full ball and drives it past the bowler to long off. Scott Edwards opens his account with a single.
Loopy and outside off, Scott covers his stumps and shoulders arms.
Flighted and full, around off, defended off the front foot.
Beauty from Liam. Tossed up again, around off and turning away with extra bounce. Scott Edwards gets on the back foot to defend but is beaten.
The skipper, Scott Edwards walks out to the middle now.

OUT! CAUGHT BEHIND! Liam Livingstone gives this one a nice toss and lands it full and outside off, at 88 kph. It lands and turns away as Max O'Dowd leans to drive it through the line. The ball though takes a thick outside edge and Jos Buttler accepts a simple catch. Max is very disappointed as he trudges back. A good knock but he would have fancied scoring a century on this excellent batting strip.
Commentary.Howout: c Jos Buttler b Liam Livingstone

Commentary.Commentary: Quicker and shorter on middle, Bas gets back and works it through mid-wicket for a run.
Around middle, tickled towards mid-wicket where the fielder fumbled and allowed a run.

FIFTY FOR MAX O'DOWD! A terrific effort from him and the crowd is applauding his effort. His 7th ODI fifty. Tossed up, outside off, Max drives it to extra cover and collects a quick run. He will be aiming for a big score here with plenty of overs left.
Nicely flighted, too full and around off, Bas de Leede knocks it down to long off for a run.
Lunges to a full ball and pushes it to covers.
Shortish and around off, de Leede gets across and wrists it towards mid-wicket.
Flighted and full, around middle, defended back.
Shortish and on middle, Bas de Leede moves back and punches it down to long on for one.
Gets forward and drives but this time picks out the fielder at covers inside the ring.
FOUR! Lovely shot! Too full in length and outside off, Bas de Leede uses a lot of wrists on this cover drive and blazes it through the gap for a boundary. Almost hockey-like, using the bottom hand.
A half-tracker again, around off, Max moves back and forces it to deep cover for one.
Loopy and full, outside off, Max O'Dowd drives but finds the cover fielder.
Flatter and quicker on off, Max goes back and punches it to deep cover for two runs.
Probably a googly that drifts on the pads. Bas de Leede works it to square leg.
Pushes it quicker on middle. Bas de Leede pushes it gently towards the leg side.
Rashid gives it a good flight again, on off. Bas de Leede blocks it off the front foot.
A googly on middle and a bit flatter. Bas de Leede works it towards deep mid-wicket for a couple.
Slower in the air, good loop on this one, on off. Max O'Dowd defends it with soft hands towards the off side for a single.
Tossed up on off. Max O'Dowd drives it to covers.
Adil Rashid is into the attack now.
The batter has just watchfully blocked this out.
Gets forward to a full ball and drives it to covers, not in the gap.
Wide! Another delivery down the leg side. Bas lets it be.
Quicker and outside off, Max O'Dowd flashes and misses. Buttler fails to collect and they steal a bye.
Wide! Fires one down the leg side, it's left alone.
Eases a full ball down to long on for a run.
In the air... Floated and around leg, Bas de Leede tries to flick but misses. It loops off the pads and Buttler catches it. They appeal but nothing doing.
Flighted and on middle, flicked through square leg for a run. 100 up!

FOUR! This time he drives and finds the gap! Carse goes a bit full but it is not exactly a haf-volley. Bas de Leede drives and drives it on up as Carse provides some width this time and the ball races away past point for a boundary.
Lands on a length, around off. Bas de Leede with a defensive shot again.
Goes full on off. Good change of length and Bas de Leede drives it without much timing towards covers.
Now, he pulls his length back further. It is outside off and Bas de Leede leaves it alone.
Hits the length hard again, on off. Bas de Leede with a solid block again.
Carse with his typical back-of-a-length delivery on middle. Bas de Leede blocks it from his crease.
Wider and slower in the air. Bas de Leede drives it to sweeper cover for a single.
Pushed quicker and flatter on off. Max O'Dowd defends it off the front foot towards the off side and a quick single is taken.
This is fuller and on middle. Bas de Leede eases it down to long on for a single.
Tossed up, around off. Bas de Leede drives it wide of long off and comes back for the second run.
Pitches around off and turns away a bit. Bas de Leede pushes it to cover-point.
Starts with a shorter-length delivery on off. Max O'Dowd pulls it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
It's time to feed some spin. Liam Livingstone gets the opportunity to bowl ahead of Adil Rashid.
On a length, on middle. Max O'Dowd clips it to fine leg for a single.
Bas de Leede, the promising young man, walks in next.

OUT! CAUGHT! Liam Livingstone with a good catch in the deep and Tom Cooper departs after a fine knock. Carse bangs it short on off, Cooper decides to take him on this time and pulls it aerially towards the deep backward square leg region. However, he fails to get enough distance and power behind his shot and Liam Livingstone moves swiftly to his right to take a fine catch. He lost the ball earlier in the sun that gave Cooper a life when he was on nought but this time he makes no mistake and takes the catch with ease and typical Liam Livingstone swag.
Commentary.Howout: c Liam Livingstone b Brydon Carse

Commentary.Commentary: Lands on a length, on off. Cooper pushes it back to the bowler.
Carse bangs it short on middle. Cooper ducks under it.

FOUR! Nicely played! On a length, around off. Cooper waits for it and then guides it to the right of the third man fielder for a boundary. The third man fielder is probably too fine there but nice timing on that shot by Cooper.
Back of a length, on off. Cooper watchfully blocks it out.

Drinks break. It's been a decent batting show from the Dutch team thus far, especially after losing Vikramjit Singh cheaply. Tom Cooper survived an early scare when his mistimed shot was not caught by Liam Livingstone as he lost the ball in the sun. Since then, Cooper has played some sumptuous shots and along with Max O'Dowd, he has raised a handy stand. The hosts would like to maintain the same tempo in the middle overs where they will be fed a bit of spin. Let's see how they progress. Jos Buttler is staying with his seam-bowling plans. Brydon Carse to continue after the break...
Pulls the length back slightly, on middle. Cooper works it through mid-wicket for a single. Good over from Curran, just 2 from it.
Sprays this length delivery on leg and Max O'Dowd clips it to fine leg for an easy single.
A short delivery on off. Max O'Dowd tries to pull it but gets the inside edge onto his pads.
Goes full again, on off. Max O'Dowd drives it to mid off.

Appeal from Curran for LBW but the umpire turns it down! A fullish delivery that is pitching around leg. Max O'Dowd looks to flick it but misses and the ball hits his pads. The appeal though is turned down as it is pitching just outside leg.
On a length, on off. Max O'Dowd blocks it off the front foot.
Well bowled! Lands on a length, close to off and it nips back in slightly. Cooper tries to work it towards the leg side but gets an inside edge onto his pads. A much-better over from Brydon Carse.
Back of a length, around off. Max O'Dowd guides it to third man for a single.
WIDE! Carse drifts this length delivery down the leg side. Max O'Dowd misses his flick shot.
Carse goes straighter this time and fuller in length. Cooper drives it to mid on for a single.
Short and wide, outside off. Cooper cuts but finds the fielder at point.
Pulls his length back a bit and delivers it close to off. Cooper defends it off the back foot.
Carse with a very full delivery, outside off. Cooper tries to drive it away but misses.
On a length, on middle. Cooper works it through mid-wicket for a single. 9 from the over, 19 in the last two.
WIDE! Short delivery and outside off this time. Cooper sets up to pull but then lets it go as it is too high and wide to get a proper connection.
Lands on a length, around off. Cooper dabs it towards point.
Curran tries a short delivery again, on middle. Max O'Dowd pulls but gets a top edge this time. Luckily for him, it falls short of the fine leg fielder and a single is taken.
Goes fuller on off. Cooper drives it to deep cover for a single.
Lands on a length, around off. Max O'Dowd steers it towards third man for a single.
FOUR! Short deliveries are not working against these two batters now! Curran bangs it short on middle. Not an express delivery and Max O'Dowd pulls it through mid-wicket for a boundary.
Nice fielding! This is overpitched delivery and outside off. Cooper drives square of the wicket but the fielder at point dives to his right and stops it.
Fullish delivery on off. Cooper drives it to mid off.
FOUR! Another short delivery and this time Cooper punishes it! Angling into leg at a nice height for Cooper to pull it. He does that in the gap towards the backward square leg fence for a boundary.

Slower delivery and fullish in length, on middle. Max O'Dowd looks to flick it but gets the inside edge onto his pads. The batters run a single as the ball rolls towards the off side. The 50-run stand comes up!

FOUR! Good shot! Max O'Dowd knew that short ball was coming and he gets into the position early here. It is a short delivery on off. Max O'Dowd pulls it in front of square towards the mid-wicket fence for a boundary.
Carse goes fuller in length, outside off. Cooper drives it to sweeper cover for a single.
Back of a length, around off. Max O'Dowd defends it from his crease.
Again that angle from 'round the wicket on middle. Cooper works it away to fine leg for a single.
Curran bangs it short, angling into off. Max O'Dowd tries to pull it but only gets a glove on it. The ball loops up in the air towards the third man region and the batters run a single.
Shortish length, on off. Max O'Dowd comes up with a solid block.
Curran comes 'round the wicket and lands it on a length, close to off. Max O'Dowd defends it towards the off side. He looks for a single but is sent back by his partner.
On a length, on middle. Max O'Dowd blocks it onto the turf.
Short and wide outside off. Cooper throws his bat at it but misses.
Carse stays with that short length and this time angling into leg. Max O'Dowd guides it to fine leg with a horizontal-bat shot for a single.
Shortish length, on off. Max O'Dowd mistimes his pull shot to mid-wicket.
Goes a bit full on off. Max O'Dowd pushes it to mid off.
On the shorter side again, around off. Good gas again from Carse. Max O'Dowd sways away from the line of the ball and defends it behind square on the off side.
Starts with a back-of-a-length delivery on middle. Cooper clips it to fine leg and takes a single.
Change from both ends. Brydon Carse to have a go now from the City End, soon to be the Borren End.
On a length and angling across the batter. Max O'Dowd defends it square off the wicket on the off side. 9 from the over, the last three overs have been really good for the Dutch team.
Pulls his length back a bit, on off. Max O'Dowd blocks it out.
Continues with that middle stump line. Cooper this time flicks it to deep square leg for a single.
Goes a bit fuller on middle. Max O'Dowd clips it to fine leg for a single.
TWO WIDES! Curran bangs it short, around off. Cooper looks to pull it but does not connect as it is too high. Buttler behind the stumps gets a glove on it and half-stops it. A bye is taken.
Lands on a length again, on off. Max O'Dowd defends it off the inside half of his blade towards the leg side for a single.
FOUR! Max O'Dowd greets Sam Curran with a boundary! On a length, on middle. Max O'Dowd waits for it and clips it towards the fine leg fence for a boundary. 50 up!

Powerplay 2 time! Now, a maximum of 4 fielders are allowed outside the ring till the 40th over. Also, we have a first bowling change of the game. Sam Curran is into the attack now. Yet another left-arm pacer on display.

Fuller and around off, Cooper tries to work it across the line but it takes the outer half of his bat and races past the diving bowler. The mid off fielder chases it down and they take a couple. 23 from the last two overs and at the end of Powerplay 1, Netherlands are 47/1.
Extra bounce from a length around off, angling away, Cooper is surprised by it as he pushes and misses.
Sliding down the leg side, on a length, Max tries to flick but misses. It hits him on the thigh pad, the bowlers appeal a bit but nothing from the umpire. They cross for a leg bye.
FOUR! Fine shot! David Payne digs it in short, around middle, Max O'Dowd gets on top of the bounce and powers it over mid-wicket for a boundary.
Aerial but safe! Delivers it on a length around middle and off, Max O'Dowd is early into the shot and chips it wide of mid off. They take a couple of runs.
Cross-seam from Payne there, on a length and outside off, Max O'Dowd tries to punch but gets beaten.

FOUR! Some great shots from the bat of Tom Cooper in this over. An on-drive, a cover drive and now a pull shot. Short in length and on middle, Tom stands tall and pulls it with authority towards the long leg fence. 14 from the over.
On a length around off, Max works it gently behind square leg and rotates the strike.
Fraction short and on middle, Cooper glances it through square leg and crosses for a run.
FOUR! Shot! Another great connection from Tom Cooper. Too full from Willey, around off and slower in pace, Cooper plants his front foot forward and drills it through extra cover.
Slightly short and around off, Tom Cooper gets behind the line and defends it down.
FOUR! High-class shot from Tom Cooper. Willey delivers it on a length and around middle, Tom shows the full face of the bat, caresses it on the up and sends it whistling down to the long on fence.
On a length and outside off, O'Dowd strokes it with an angled bat but finds the point fielder.
Angling away from the batter, Max again moves across a bit in his stance, tries to play inside the line but misses.
Fuller and outside off, Max gets across the stumps and pushes it solidly to the off side, finds the cover fielder.

FOUR! Now a misfield off Payne's bowling. He delivers it on a good length and outside off, Max O'Dowd opens the face of his blade and it races down to third man where Adil Rashid fumbles and it goes to the fence.
Fuller in length and wide outside off, Max O'Dowd crunches his drive square of the wicket on the off side. Roy dives from point and makes a nice stop to his left.
Serves it in the line of the stumps, on a length, Max defends it to the off side.
Gets behind the line of the delivery and pushes it to mid off.
Turns a length ball in the gap at mid-wicket for a run.
The batter has just blocked that from his crease.
Fuller and around off, pushed with an angled bat to point.
On a length around middle, eased behind square leg for a run.
Sharp inswinger, around off, Tom Cooper defends it from the inner half of his bat.

WHAT HAPPENED THERE? Liam Livingstone loses it completely in the sun. Everyone is laughing, apart from David Payne. The debutant digs it in short and around middle, Cooper tries to heave but it comes from the higher half of his blade. Liam Livingstone settles underneath it, it looks like an easy catch at mid-wicket but Livingstone loses the ball and it drops safely. They cross for a run. Good from Payne to go and pat Liam on the back.
Another drive from the bat of Cooper but this time he picks out the wide mid off fielder.
Full and wide outside off, Cooper drives this time but finds the fielder at covers.
Loose from someone of Cooper's calibre. Width there outside off, short in length, Tom goes chasing after it but fails to connect.
Taps it down towards point and takes a single.
Fuller and on off, it's pushed off the front foot to mid off.
Slants across a length ball outside off, Cooper covers the line and shoulders arms.
Tom Cooper walks in at number 3.

OUT! CAUGHT! A 139 kph short delivery, around off and hurrying the batter. Vikramjit Singh tries to pull it across the line off the front foot but mistimes it badly. It loops in the air off the shoulder of his blade and Dawid Malan takes the catch running forward in front of square leg. David Willey continues to dominate Vikramjit Singh - has dismissed him in all the games of this series now, twice while pulling.
Commentary.Howout: c Dawid Malan b David Willey

Commentary.Commentary: Pitches it up and outside off, Max strokes it to the left of deepish mid off and collects a single.
Slightly short and around off, Max O'Dowd tries to work it around but misses and it goes off his thigh pad to the off side.
FOUR! Bang! Max O'Dowd shows some intent there. Back of a length, outside off, Max O'Dowd gives the charge and clobbers it through covers for a boundary. The crowd rejoice.
Fine leg comes up and square leg drops back.
Wide! Some inward movement there for Willey but it starts from around leg and goes down the leg side. Max O'Dowd tries to flick but misses.
Feeds it on a length and gets it to slide away from the batter, O'Dowd pushes inside the line and misses.
Gets forward to a full ball and drives it to covers, finds Livingstone.
Wide! Sprays a length ball down the leg side, Singh fails to flick.
Fuller and outside off, Max O'Dowd drives it to the left of mid off and picks up a single.
Around off, on a length and angling away, Max defends it with an angled bat to point.
Drifting down the leg side, Vikramjit Singh tries to nudge it around but it takes his pads and runs down to fine leg. They cross for a leg bye.
Angling in this time, on a good length, Singh goes hard at it and punches it a bit aerially towards mid on.

EDGY FOUR! Here comes the first boundary of the match. David Payne lands it on a good length around off, shaping away, Vikramjit Singh stays back to punch it through the line but it takes the outside edge and flies wide of second slip. It scoots away to the fence at third man.
Close to off, on a good length, Max sticks on the back foot and defends it down safely. Three excellent overs from England so far.
Fuller and outside off, Singh slices his attempted drive past the point fielder and picks up a single.
Superb delivery. Willey gets a length ball to curl away from around off, Vikramjit Singh tries to drive without any footwork and is beaten.
On a good length and around off, Singh stays back and eases it towards mid off.
Angles it in, around off, on a fuller length, Vikramjit Singh covers the line and defends it watchfully.
Fuller and on off, Singh is on the front foot as he blocks it to the off side.
Beaten on the drive! Fuller in length and outside off, Max O'Dowd tries driving but misses on the inside edge. A maiden to start for the debutant.
A bit edgy. David Payne delivers it on a length around middle, Max O'Dowd tries to defend with a straight bat but it takes the inner edge and rolls to mid-wicket.
Around off, on a good length, Max O'Dowd goes on the back foot an defensively pushes it to mid off.
Lands it fuller and around off, trying to bend it in, Max pushes it down past the bowler to mid on.
Beats the bat! Back of a length, around off and nipping away, Max O'Dowd feels for it inside the line and misses.
Fuller and around off, Max O'Dowd gets forward and pushes it to the off side.
The debutant, David Payne will share the new ball with David Willey.
Pitches it up and around off, Singh drives it down to mid on. Dot ball to end the first over.
Edgy! Extra bounce from a good length around off, O'Dowd tries to withdraw his bat but it takes the outside edge and runs down to third man. A single is taken.
Back of a length and outside off, Max stays on the back foot and plays it down to cover-point.
Play and a miss. Angling away from the right-hander, on a length and outside off, Max O'Dowd pushes inside the line and misses.
The Dutch are underway. Willey shortens his length a bit and delivers it outside off, Vikramjit Singh goes back and runs it down to third man for a single.
David Willey begins with a full ball, around off, Vikramjit Singh drives well but finds the mid off fielder.

We are all set to begin! England players make their way out to the middle. Vikramjit Singh and Max O'Dowd are the openers for Netherlands. David Willey has a new ball in his hand. Vikramjit Singh to take the strike. Here we go...

Scott Edwards, the skipper of Netherlands, says that they were pretty much on track in the last game and adds that the two wickets, in the end, stopped them from getting that 260-run mark. Mentions that this fresh pitch will probably suit them and it will get slower. Informs that they have two changes in their playing XI and says that they are enjoying playing against England.

Jos Buttler, the stand-in skipper for England, says that they are bowling as the pitch is fresh and will stay the same throughout. Feels that if there is anything for the bowlers, it will be upfront. Informs that Eoin Morgan is missing as he has a groin injury.  Also adds that they have included Sam Curran and handed a debut to David Payne.

Netherlands (Playing XI) - Vikramjit Singh, Max O'Dowd, Tom Cooper, Bas de Leede, Scott Edwards (C) (WK), Teja Nidamanuru, Logan van Beek, Tim Pringle, Aryan Dutt, Paul van Meekeren (In place of Shane Snater), Fred Klaassen (In place of Vivian Kingma).

England (Playing XI) - Jason Roy, Philip Salt, Dawid Malan, Jos Buttler (C) (WK), Liam Livingstone, Moeen Ali, Sam Curran (In place of Eoin Morgan), Adil Rashid, David Willey, Brydon Carse, David Payne (On debut) (In place of Reece Topley).
TOSS - The coin goes up and lands in favour of Jos Buttler. ENGLAND ELECT TO BOWL!

England, on the other hand, have been clinical so far with both batting and bowling firing in unison. However, the form of their skipper, Eoin Morgan has been a concern and there is some further bad news coming out from Amstelveen for Morgan's fans as he has been ruled out of this final ODI with a groin injury. Jos Buttler will be leading the side in his absence. On the other side, Philip Salt has grabbed his opportunity with both hands and with the kind of depth and firepower England have in their ranks, they would be looking to wrap up this series with another big win. Can Netherlands outclass England in the final showdown? Or will England once again dominate the proceedings? Let’s find out. Toss and team sheets in a while.
